terminal_condition: changed returns RecvError only when channel is closed and current value is already seen
reopen_posture: Sender::subscribe may reopen the channel by creating a new receiver
residual_delivery_posture: current latest value still exists and can remain observable even while closed
claim_ceiling: closure observation is receiver-count driven; does not imply full lifecycle quiescence
notes: keep separate from latest-value-only memory class
closed is not the same thing as permanently terminated
